evidence.quote: SAXENDA is indicated in combination with a reduced calorie diet and increased physical activity to reduce excess body weight and maintain weight reduction long term in: - Adults and pediatric patients aged 12 years and older with body weight greater than 60 kg and obesity.

SAXENDA is an injectable prescription medicine used for adults with obesity or overweight (excess weight) who also have weight related medical problems, and children aged 12 to 17 years with a body weight above 132 pounds (60 kg) and obesity to help them lose weight and keep the weight off.

response.reasoning: All elements of the claim, including the diet/activity requirement, the target population (adults and children 12+ weighing >60kg with obesity), and the goal of weight loss and maintenance, are explicitly stated in the indications and medication guide.
